content: सूतिः, सूती {%f.%} [सू-क्तिन्] .²1 Birth, production, parturition, delivery, child-bearing. .²2 Offspring, progeny. .²3 Source, fountain-head; तपसां सूतिरसूतिरापदाम् <ls>Ki. 2. 56</ls>. .²4 A place where Soma juice is extracted. .²5 Yielding fruit, production of crops; न कल्पते पुनः सूत्या उप्तं बीजं च नश्यति <ls>Bhāg. 7. 11. 33</ls>.
